title: Plasmid sequence annotator

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: The 1,500 bp placeholder is synthetic: random backbone around a lac promoter, an ORF, an rrnB T1-like terminator, EcoRI and BamHI sites, and M13 primer sites (M13 rev appears on both strands, which is what the motif search in turn 3 is for). Coordinates are 1-based and inclusive. Features and the pasted sequence are kept in localStorage.
